text:
Maya: Heads-up — mobile SDK streaming connections drop ~5s after token refresh on RN Bridge. Happens on iOS and Android.
Jon: Do you have logs from the reconnect? stack trace or http status?
Maya: we see a 401 on the browser preflight occasionally when the app replays the auth headers. RN logs show `STREAM_DISCONNECTED` then a reconnect loop.
Priya: Are you using ephemeral tokens or long-lived API keys in the bridge?
Maya: ephemeral. flow: app requests short token from /auth, passes to SDK. When it expires, SDK does refresh -> new token. On refresh the streaming socket disconnects and the browser/webview preflight fails with CORS 401.
Rui: Two things to check: 1) the RN native module isn't reattaching headers on reconnect; 2) the webview's fetch preflight might use cached old header if the JS bridge doesn't update the cookie/header atomically.
Jon: Can you paste the auth header mutation code? suspect race in async setState -> native call.
Maya: simplified snippet:

```
// RN JS
await fetch('/auth'); // get { token }
setState({ token });
// native bridge send
NativeModules.Redwood.startStream(token);
```

We sometimes call startStream before native bridge sees the updated token.
Priya: For Swift wrapper we had to expose a `resumeWithToken(_:)` that atomically swaps the token and resumes the socket. Otherwise there's a race where native reconnect uses stale auth.
Maya: interesting — our Kotlin wrapper uses a var on the module that we mutate. maybe not thread-safe.
Rui: Another angle: on the hosted side we saw the preflight fail because `Access-Control-Allow-Headers` didn't include `x-redwood-auth` for OPTIONS from the webview origin. Browser preflight 401 + server rejects OPTIONS -> socket creation fails. Mobile webviews still obey CORS.
Maya: ah — that matches browser-only repros.
Jon: Quick mitigation: have the SDK send a short `heartbeat` request with new token to `/v1/_auth_check` before starting the socket. That will ensure the token is usable and primes the server.
Maya: implemented quick patch in my fork, adding `await checkAuth(token)` before startStream; reduces 401s.
Sam: build-bot triggered: build/ci #4721 queued for maya/mobile-auth-fix
build-bot: CI started for branch maya/mobile-auth-fix — unit tests + smoke.
Priya: For a proper fix we should: 1) expose atomic resume API in Swift/Kotlin, 2) make RN bridge update token synchronously when possible, 3) add server-side OPTIONS include for x-redwood-auth, 4) add e2e covering token rotate while streaming.
Jon: Also add a reconnect backoff to avoid hot loops when refresh fails.
Maya: I'll open a PR with the JS quick-fix + an issue tracking native wrappers + server CORS change. PR will include the snippet and test plan.
Sam: PR #2215 linked? please paste when ready.
Maya: will do. @Priya can you review native wrapper change if I send the Kotlin diff?
Priya: yep, happy to. I'll also add a small integration test in the iOS harness.
Jon: thanks team. tagging this for postmortem notes and can we add to mobile SDK release notes: "fix: streaming reconnect on token refresh" :thumbsup:
Maya: thanks, merging after CI green and @Priya review.
